data.name: [NSG Core] Dashing Mad
data.description: Phoenix personifies the Anarch philosophy of moving fast and breaking things; except for Detente -- a console that puts even more pressure on cards in HQ -- this deck is most what people call a "reg deck", a deck that runs generically good cards. The deciding factor here is not which cards you play, but how you play them; sometimes, your Rent Rioters are better off sacc'ed to a Tithe if that means sticking it to them execs. Shred normally functions as a tech card against strategies that rely on powerful upgrades to protect their agendas, but by squeezing HQ tight, Ryo can use Shred more liberally.
